name: lc_mod_depot
note: our canal module "depot", canal and all, taken off the ring on 24 November (the owner: save it as a prefab): the Combine's ration depot: a roller door, a loading bay, caged stores, a staff door. Heads east from its anchor (the canal's middle at its entry, on the canal's floor). The module itself still builds: map_build.py module --name depot
